rules.statement: Every granted fragment is contained in one of the grantor's own ALLOWs and overlaps no non-Anyone DENY the grantor is subject to.
properties: control:GrantPropertyTest#A5 the grant analysis is sound
control:GrantPropertyTest#A8 changes analyzed as contained never grant beyond the grantors
engine:PatternContainmentPropertyTest#A7 typed resource containment is sound
engine:PatternContainmentPropertyTest#A7 http path containment is sound

rules.statement: A fragment the analysis cannot decide goes to platform administrator approval; it is never let through as probably contained.
properties: control:GrantPropertyTest#A5 the grant analysis is sound
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#what the analysis cannot prove waits for another person's approval of its digest
